Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202214 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2022-03-14 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The Karnataka Civil Services (Validation of Selection and appointment of 2011 batch Gazettedprobationers) Act, 2022. Long Title: Whereas, in Notification dated 03.11.2011, applications were invited by the Karnataka Public Service Commission from eligible candidates for filling up of 362 Group-A and Group-B posts. The Preliminary Examination was conducted on 22.04.2012. The main examination was held from 15.12.2012 to 06.01.2013. Result of the examination was published on 21.03.2013.
